master_directives.title: Dynamic Regime-Adaptive Tuning & Elastic Margin (RULE-095, RULE-072, RULE-055)
master_directives.summary: Live VIX dictates deployment: Calm (VIX<18) = 65% Margin ($20.9k), 60/40 Sprint/Anchor Barbell; Churn (18<=VIX<24) = 55% Margin, 50/50 mix; Storm (VIX>=24) = 45% Margin, 30/70 mix + Index Condors. Always maintain 35%-55% liquid cash floor.

master_directives.title: Decoupled 8-Sector Universe & Trend Protection (RULE-037, RULE-050, RULE-089)
master_directives.summary: Screen across 8 non-overlapping themes. Mandatory earnings blackout gate between trade date and expiration (ETFs exempt). Strict SMA20 trend filter rejects falling knives (spot < SMA20).

master_directives.title: Merit-First Progressive Scaling & Re-Entry Penalties (RULE-072, RULE-082)
master_directives.summary: Never force rotation into weak, low-scoring candidates. Underlying concentration allows up to 3 tranches with progressive penalties (-15 pts for Tranche 2, -25 pts for Tranche 3). Theme cap = 3 (Index = 4).

master_directives.title: Multi-Factor Scoring, Box Discount & Skew Bonus (RULE-045, RULE-062, RULE-083)
master_directives.summary: Prioritize prior-session box discount (0%-35% PDL range). Harvest elevated 25-delta put skew (+15% credit bonus). Require positive VRP edge floor (IV/HV >= 1.08 low vol, 1.15 standard).

master_directives.title: Autonomous Execution Timeline & Golden Window (RULE-054, RULE-086)
master_directives.summary: 19:35 ICT Universe Screener -> 20:50 ICT Liquidity Radar -> 21:15 ICT Master Golden Hour Entry. 5-minute automated harvest sweeps run continuously during market hours.

master_directives.title: Native Atomic MLEG & 90-Second Micro-Walk (RULE-047, RULE-052, RULE-084)
master_directives.summary: All credit spreads placed as native atomic multi-leg (mleg) limit orders. Zero market orders. Dynamic 90-second micro-walk from Natural credit toward Midpoint with penny-pilot calibration and 12.5% ROC floor.

master_directives.title: Dual-Account Real-Money Routing & Cash Velocity (RULE-073, RULE-078, RULE-091)
master_directives.summary: Alpaca Live ($30.1k) executes Primary Hybrid Barbell (up to 6 slots, $2,500/slot). Tradier Live ($2.0k) executes High-Velocity Sprints (2 slots, $600/slot). IBKR ($2.2k) is 100% quarantined.

master_directives.title: Precision Index Iron Condor Protocol (RULE-094)
master_directives.summary: On broad market indexes (SPY, QQQ, IWM), deploy dual-wing Iron Condors when consolidating (box 35%-65%, VRP >= 1.10). Single-margin collateral efficiency doubles cash yield in rangebound regimes.

master_directives.title: Adaptive FastHarvest & Terminal Theta Policy (RULE-077, RULE-085)
master_directives.summary: Auto-harvest spreads at 50% profit (DTE > 3). At terminal window (DTE <= 3d): if deeply safe (buffer >= 2.5%) and profit < 90%, let theta burn to 100% expiry; harvest early only if profit >= 90% (to bank gains and avoid pin risk) or if buffer is threatened (< 2.0%).

master_directives.title: Proactive Strike-Touch Sentinel & Gamma Cliff Defense (RULE-087, RULE-090)
master_directives.summary: Monitor spot vs short strike continuously. If spot breaches short strike or delta exceeds danger threshold before 21 DTE, trigger proactive stop-out order to prevent gamma explosion and catastrophic loss.

master_directives.title: Spread-Level Harvest De-duplication & Order Cooldown (RULE-092)
master_directives.summary: Enforce strict cooldown locks on individual closed spread keys (symbol + strikes + expiration) to prevent duplicate closing orders during 5-minute poller sweeps. Ticker-level re-entries remain 100% governed by Merit-First scoring and progressive re-entry penalties (DIR-03).

master_directives.title: Self-Healing Healer, Zero-Synthetic Truth & Excel Ledger (RULE-051, RULE-053, RULE-088, RULE-093)
master_directives.summary: Zero synthetic or hardcoded prices permitted. T+10s self-healing sweep pairs or liquidates orphaned single legs. Auto-log every fill, harvest, and stopout to 3-sheet SkonVault_Live_Transaction_Journal.xlsx.

master_directives.title: The 4 Reproducibility Rules & High-Win-Rate Wide Spread Standard (RULE-096, RULE-097, RULE-098)
master_directives.summary: Institutionalize the 4 pillars of consistent spread wins: (1) OTM Buffer Floor >= 5.0% (>= 7.0% for DTE < 14); (2) 14-30 DTE Gamma Shield; (3) 18-Delta target on $25w-$30w wide spreads with max 3 contracts and up to 35% capital scaling; (4) SMA20 uptrend & institutional Put Wall alignment.
